ops.title: malloc_zone_pressure_relief(NULL,0) releases nothing for freed cc_transcript parse graphs on macOS 26.7.1
ops.body:
Measured 2026-10-14 23:17 PDT in a private probe run by the installed Captain Hook 12.94.2 Python with cc_transcript 14.43.0. The probe ran with `CC_TRANSCRIPT_PARSE_THREADS=2` on macOS 26.7.1 (25G241), arm64. Its root-granted job slot covered one process and no attach to any other.

- **Phase A, real parse graphs.** The probe made 55 parses of 9 subagent transcripts (126.9 MiB of source) and retained all of them. Peak: 237 MiB malloc in use, 229 MiB footprint. After freeing them, RSS was 219.7 MiB, footprint 127.0 MiB, and malloc in use 7.6 MiB. vmmap showed `MALLOC_SMALL (empty)` at 144.1 MiB resident and 66.9 MiB dirty across 48 regions.
- **Phase B, raw small blocks.** The probe made 40,780 `malloc` calls of 1.5 to 12 KiB, 224 MiB in total, touched every block, then freed them all. After freeing, RSS was 447.9 MiB and footprint 208.6 MiB.

In both phases, `malloc_zone_pressure_relief(NULL, 0)` returned **0 bytes** in about 0.02 ms. RSS, footprint, malloc in-use and reserved bytes, and vmmap's empty-small resident and dirty figures were identical before and after. Calling it a second time also returned 0.

Decision: Captain Hook does not call it at worker quiescence. It would be a no-op on the hot path. The worker's memory is bounded instead by keeping only one transcript graph live at a time, as cc-skills #451 does for the rotation lane scan. Freed small regions already drop out of `phys_footprint`, and their remaining RSS is reusable pages the kernel reclaims under pressure. Do not add RSS-threshold or manager-driven worker retirement in its place.

Receipts: `/tmp/host-relief-20261013-1823/allocator-probe/probe.json`, and `capt-worker-durable-progress.json` (`probe`, `allocator_relief_policy`). Inputs: `/tmp/host-relief-20261013-1823/capt-worker-heap-diagnosis.json`, and worker 80616's vmmap (5.8 GiB peak footprint, 284 MiB footprint at rest, 6.9 GiB RSS of which 4.0 GiB was `MALLOC_SMALL (empty)` resident at 7 MiB dirty).
